rounds.text: Visaka Industries Ltd is fundamentally undervalued and demonstrating powerful operational inflection points that the market has yet to fully price in. The company trades at an attractive P/E of 12.6 and a price-to-book ratio of just 1.03x against a book value of 95.7 [E1, E2]. Profitability has dramatically rebounded, highlighted by a massive 597% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months and operating cash flow surging to Rs 183 Cr in March 2026, where profits were fully backed by cash at a conversion rate of 2.15x [E13, E25, E26]. Management has also executed significant balance sheet cleanup, slashing borrowings down to Rs 303 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 479 Cr a year earlier, while promoters demonstrated strong internal conviction by increasing their stake to 53.40% [E30, E32]. Operational efficiency is structurally improving, evidenced by annual operating margins expanding consistently over the last four years and reaching 15% in June 2026 [E23, E24]. Conceded: [E7, E11, E18, E54].
